title: Commonwealth Gas Company files for approval eight (8) agreements for quasi-firm transportation service between itself and the following customers: Baystate/Sterling, Inc., Holy Cross College, Independent Plating, Milford Whitinsville Regional Hospital, Perkit Folding Box Corp., Tilcon-Capaldi, Inc., University of Massachusetts Medical School and Worcester City Campus Corp.
filings: The Department APPROVES the Company's Revised Standard Form Quasi-Firm Transportation Service Agreement as the Company's new Standard Form Quasi-Firm Transportation Service Agreement. Also, the Department GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure the pricing terms and minimum quantity of therms to be purchased under the Agreements. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
Commonwealth Gas Company revised Attachment 1 to the filing made on April 26, 1999. By: John Cope Flanagan.
